snippet.title: LIDAR.EXE - Indie Horror Game - No Commentary
snippet.description:
Thanks For Watching!

Facebook https://www.facebook.com/Stella-Abbasi-100150965166877/
Twitter https://twitter.com/StellaAbbasi

Download https://kenforest.itch.io/lidar-exe

You are in a dark space, you can't see anything. You only have a lidar scanner with which you can scan the area. You wander through the corridors in the hope of finding a way out of this gloomy place.

Indie Horror Game Playlist https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLk0tZ0YT3FZEsIgd3Qdj19xGe9VcMMI1P

#Lidar #Indiegames
